## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 18 sept 2026 - 3 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Mein Name_, 3 oct 2026, 1/5: "completely useless if in spreadsheets lines do not stick together when sorting. It's also buggy as hell. When I tap "freeze row" nothing happens. And for some reason it keeps overwriting while I am typing. a complete mess but I would have still used it if I could sort my data correctly."
            2. _Monitor ePublications AR_, 25 sept 2026, 2/5: "Won't open password protected files as of 9-26, prior to that usually stable. Known new issue, awaiting fix."
            3. _Aaren Arnolds_, 23 sept 2026, 2/5: "The idea behind the app is excellent, but the app itself is not worth it. Typing is constantly laggy, and the documents often bug out and can't be edited unless you close then open them again. Text selecting tool is awful; it teleports from what you're trying to select onto text that needs to stay unselected. Buttons are desynced, I need to hit Bold in order to italicise, or Italics to underline. Formatting settings are kinda awkward and also laggy. Shame, considering it's the best option."
<!--/ir-theme-->
